divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: records on four non-primary contigs of the GRCh38 cache: the assembly patch HG1012_PATCH, the alternate haplotype HSCHR17_1_CTG1, the unplaced scaffold KI270728.1 and the LRG region LRG_1; positions placed from the contigs' transcript models (exon boundaries, splice sites, codons, UTRs, introns, 5 kb flanks) with the reference alleles read from the GRCh38 assembly sequence of each contig
generator: candidate records on five non-primary contigs annotated with Ensembl VEP, then tools/vep-golden-corpus select --k 1 --seed 1 --max-records 300 --cache <converted slice>; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the slice tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP cache's HG1012_PATCH, HSCHR17_1_CTG1, KI270728.1, GL000008.2 and LRG_1 directories (no GL000008.2 record was selected); tools/vep-golden-corpus classify

summary_log.annotation_rows: equal to the expected outputs' rows; the two runs differ only in the header lines that name a time, the cache path or the command line
